advisoryFindings.title: Normalized preview not distinguished from raw response
advisoryFindings.improvement: Use a response shape where normalization would visibly change the preview, such as surrounding whitespace or JSON code fences, so the test proves the preview is based on the normalized agent response rather than the raw stdout string.
advisoryFindings.whyNonBlocking: The current test still covers the required file-name diagnostic and 200-character cap; this is a stronger boundary check rather than missing executable coverage.
